build_gpt_vae_model: build a GPT VAE model that encodes sequences into latent distributions and autoregressively decodes them
encode_sequences_to_latents: encode token sequences into variational latent representations using the GPT VAE encoder
generate_sequences_with_latents: generate autoregressive token sequences conditioned on learned latent vectors
compute_vae_training_loss: compute combined autoregressive and KL divergence loss for GPT VAE training
review_gpt_vae_class: review the GPTVAE class that applies CVAE and DETR design from ACT to a GPT transformer
